layout.clock: Active gameplay clock. Three short arrival/gag lines run during the safe playable0..8s phase. Any remaining blocking overlay holds the clock at8s and prevents hazards until dismissed. Pause freezes all clocks. Retry skips gag text but retains0..8s calm phase.

scheduler.rng: Dedicated RNG from run seed plus fixed salt99002; never consume level1 or unrelated RNG. Same runseed+same hero path gives same placements.
scheduler.type_bag: Fisher-Yates shuffle of all8 IDs. Consume one only when prop actually spawns. Refill only afterall8 consumed. Same retry seed resets bag/wave state. No cap-dependent discard.
scheduler.occupancy: Wave count is the exact number of simultaneously falling props from spawn through impact, including initial visible warnings. Exclude water floats/splashes. Maximum five. Spawn the next cohort immediately after the previous cohort lands. No shooting, destruction, early refill or missing-count exceptions.
scheduler.wave_boundary: At exactboundary resolve prior impacts before spawningnextcohort; never six-plus falling objects. Counts change atfirstwave whoseat>=stageboundary.
scheduler.late_frame: Use fixed/substepped simulation or swepttime processing; do not skip elapsed cohorts or silently discard spawns on cap. No framebased RNG.
scheduler.phase_end: At35 disable damage and clearwarning/projectiletokens before finalimpact. Preserve lastcohort visiblylanding asharmless floatingprops, allfloatsdrainunderwatercurrent during35..43. No silentvisualdeletion.

flush.trigger: 8s debris phase start; short route-specific exchange, no accumulated queue

drain.trigger: 35s safe automatic drain phase through43; short shout only

cues.generation_brief: Generic panicked burbling/drowning scream fading away while the fictional hero is pulled down the drain and disappears. Three seconds, no dialogue, no actual person voice imitation.
cues.provenance: Original deterministic sample-free synthesis; no human recordings, voice models or third-party samples. Fictional nonverbal effect, not an imitation of Tony, Sean or another person.
cues.rights: Project-generated material; no third-party sample license or attribution obligations.
cues.status: First pass; no subjective listening approval.

events.current_loop: Start once on active bowl entry, one looping voice, fade in/out over 0.25s; stop at chute/log checkpoint.
events.flush_onset: One-shot at full-flush phase transition, never per frame or per current-strength update.
events.flush_surge: One-shot on chute entry/final pull; do not restart continuously or loop.
events.debris_impact: Debris landing or player impact; one shared effect voice, throttle at least 0.12s.
events.debris_break: Successful soft obstruction destruction once, prioritize over impact in same frame.
events.radio_chirp: Once per radio transmission/exchange, not each character or text line; minimum 0.5s cooldown.

audio.lifecycle: Suggested four fixed voices: current bed, flush accent, debris, radio. New onset/surge may replace previous flush accent. Pause all; honor SFX mute; stop and clear on death/retry/title/scene exit/disposal. No muted-event backlog.
audio.radio_mix: During radio overlay duck current and flush accent an additional 8dB, restore over 0.2s. Chirp before transmission text/voice; no voice recording supplied. Keep impact/weapon cues bounded. Device mix remains unreviewed.
audio.loop_import: current-loop.wav only: enable forward loop across full 128000 frames. Other WAVs must not loop. Circular overlap already baked in; no restart gaps.
audio.candidate_registration: Six initial candidates named by event; Engineering allocates new permanent slot IDs and next suffixes, preserves these exact source assets, registers candidates, refreshes runtime mappings, rebuilds audio/drain-damage-sound-auditions.html and runs --check. Audio does not edit shared registry/helper.
audio.validation: All six WAVs decode with ffmpeg; Python syntax and 120-column/trailing-whitespace checks pass. Exact hashes/levels/seam measurements in manifest. No playback or subjective approval.
audio.preservation: Keep all six original WAVs and this recipe; future revisions use new versioned paths. Existing death flush remains unchanged.
audio.limitations: Numerical loop boundary check does not establish perceived seamlessness. Runtime, lifecycle tests, mixing, build and roadmap remain Engineering work.
